explanation: L4/N1979+ is a retrospective register neuron: it turns on across a whole passage of technical, scientific or computing exposition (source code, API and reference documentation, research abstracts, engineering or product specifications) and stays near zero in narrative, journalistic and personal writing and in non-Latin scripts. The state builds over long-range context - an identical sentence peaks at 3.2 after a technical paragraph but at 0.5 after a narrative one - and inside an active passage the largest values land on the word-onset tokens of technical terms (type names, identifiers, jargon nouns) and on the conditional connectives 'when'/'if', so no fixed token list triggers it.
